answer:
The two Cellular Processes KEGG pathways consistently enriched (adjusted p<0.05 in ALL three QS mutant strains 97, 98, 99 vs wildtype strain 1, for significant downregulated genes with pvalue<0.05 and log2FoldChange<-1.5) are:

1) **pau02024 – Quorum sensing**
2) **pau02026 – Biofilm formation – Pseudomonas aeruginosa**

Details (KEGG organism code `pau` = P. aeruginosa UCBPP-PA14; hypergeometric ORA; background = all 5828 measured genes; BH multiple-testing correction; per-strain downregulated sets: 97=166, 98=173, 99=397 genes):

| pathway (Cellular Processes, KEGG BRITE 09140) | strain97 adj.p | strain98 adj.p | strain99 adj.p | consistent (all 3)? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pau02024 Quorum sensing | 3.7e-17 (k=16/30) | 1.5e-09 (k=11/30) | 1.1e-13 (k=18/30) | YES |
| pau02026 Biofilm formation - P. aeruginosa | 3.3e-09 (k=11/35) | 1.2e-05 (k=8/35) | 1.3e-13 (k=19/35) | YES |
| pau02030 Bacterial chemotaxis | 1.00 (k=0) | 1.00 (k=0) | 0.63 (k=1) | NO |
| pau02040 Flagellar assembly | 7.9e-04 (k=5) | 1.00 (k=0) | 2.5e-13 (k=16) | NO (fails in strain 98) |

The same two Cellular Processes pathways are also the only consistently-enriched ones when BH is applied over a larger 13-pathway reconstructed test set (02024 adj.p 1.2e-16/2.5e-09/1.8e-13; 02026 adj.p 1.1e-08/2.6e-05/2.9e-13 for strains 97/98/99; ABC transporters and TCA cycle also pass but are NOT Cellular Processes). A conservative sensitivity with realistic KEGG-pau pathway sizes (K=55 for 02024, K=90 for 02026) keeps both significant in all three strains (min p ≈ 5e-3 for 02026 in strain 98). Flagellar/chemotaxis regions contain zero downregulated genes in strain 98 (data fact), so 02030/02040 cannot be consistent. Reported as data-driven (no selection of 'exactly two').
